advocacy_greeting.purpose: Welcome the returning user by name, acknowledge their progress with one concrete metric, and set the stage for a performance review.

performance_review.purpose: Present the user's dashboard metrics in flowing sentences, then use Socratic questioning to help them identify their biggest skill gap (self_assessment + identified_gap).

gap_deepdive.purpose: Explore WHY the identified gap exists and WHEN it shows up — build enough context to give a truly personalized recommendation.

personalized_nudge.purpose: Give a rich, contextual plan tied to gap_context and gap_scenario — not just an exercise suggestion but a reasoned approach the user can start today.

engagement_wrapup.purpose: Close the conversation gracefully when the user declines to engage or after the nudge commitment is captured.
